reference_sql:
WITH versions AS (  -- one row per price version, with the price of the version before
  SELECT product_id, valid_from, list_price_eur,
         LAG(list_price_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS prev_price_eur
  FROM price_history
  WHERE product_id BETWEEN 1 AND 25
)
SELECT product_id, valid_from, prev_price_eur, list_price_eur
FROM versions
WHERE list_price_eur < prev_price_eur

SELECT v.product_id, v.valid_from, v.prev_price_eur, v.list_price_eur
FROM (
  -- one row per price version, with the price of the version before
  SELECT product_id, valid_from, list_price_eur,
         LAG(list_price_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS prev_price_eur
  FROM price_history
  WHERE product_id BETWEEN 1 AND 25
) AS v
WHERE v.list_price_eur < v.prev_price_eur

SELECT product_id, valid_from,
       LAG(list_price_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS prev_price_eur,
       list_price_eur
FROM price_history
WHERE product_id BETWEEN 1 AND 25
QUALIFY list_price_eur < LAG(list_price_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY valid_from)

SELECT cur.product_id, cur.valid_from, prev.list_price_eur AS prev_price_eur, cur.list_price_eur
FROM price_history cur
JOIN price_history prev
  ON prev.product_id = cur.product_id
 AND prev.valid_from = (SELECT MAX(p.valid_from) FROM price_history p WHERE p.product_id = cur.product_id AND p.valid_from < cur.valid_from)
WHERE cur.product_id BETWEEN 1 AND 25
  AND cur.list_price_eur < prev.list_price_eur

solver.query:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT product_id, valid_from,
         LAG(list_price_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS prev_price_eur,
         list_price_eur
  FROM price_history
  WHERE product_id BETWEEN 1 AND 25
)
SELECT product_id, valid_from, prev_price_eur, list_price_eur
FROM v
WHERE prev_price_eur IS NOT NULL AND list_price_eur < prev_price_eur
